description: RAPID: Multi-Hazard Performance of Load Bearing Wall Systems: A Case Study Following the January 2010 Earthquake and October 2016 Hurricane Matthew is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Tracy Kijewski-Correa, University of Notre Dame (nd.edu). Strengthening community resilience to natural disasters depends critically on improving construction practices across a private sector dominated by low-rise buildings. This issue becomes particularly urgent for coastal communities where hurricane risk is escalating under a changing climate and rising seas. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/DS2K385. Keywords: Haiti, Hurricane Matthew, storm surge, wind, hurricane, reconnaissance. Published 2017-12-01. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the DesignSafe listing (publication licences offered are CC BY 4.0, ODC-By, CC0 and GPL; project page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
